system.description:
You create a wall of shimmering force to block the movement of physical objects.

Draw a line up to 10 spaces long, or a circle with a radius between 1-2 spaces. Each space must be within 30 spaces of you.

A structure of force appears in the selected area. This wall is 2 spaces high and lasts until the start of your next turn.

When you cast this spell, each creature within the affected area may make an opposed Reflexes check to immediately move to either side of the wall. Otherwise, it is forcibly moved to the side that you choose.

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. Spells and energy can pass freely.

Each extra success extends the duration of the wall by +1 rounds.
